Co-SMOS v1.2.1 — Admin UI: Queue-based task submission + Run Next

CONTEXT:
- Repo: Urania-order/jules
- Backend: smos/api/main.py (already has POST /api/admin/run)
- Frontend: frontend/index.html (view-admin with admin-command, admin-args, admin-run)
- Existing: scripts/jules-queue-runner.sh uses .jules/queue/{pending,running,completed}/
- Existing: scripts/run-task.sh — full cycle for ONE file
  - accepts any path (verified: TASK_FILE=$1, cat "$TASK_FILE")
  - compatible with running/admin-*.txt
- User wants: in Admin UI, submit task text -> queue -> run next from queue

GOAL:

1. Backend: new endpoints in smos/api/main.py

   a) POST /api/admin/queue/add
      - Body: {text: str, verify_task: Optional[str]}
      - Writes .jules/queue/pending/admin-<uuid8>.txt
        Content: task text (raw prompt)
      - Optional sidecar: .jules/queue/pending/admin-<uuid8>.meta.json
        {"verify_task": "11", "created_at": "...", "by": "operator"}
      - Response: {queued: true, filename: "admin-<uuid8>.txt"}
      - Auth: operator/admin

   b) POST /api/admin/queue/run-next
      - Picks OLDEST .txt from .jules/queue/pending/
      - If none: 400 {error: "next_task_not_formed", message: "No pending task files"}
      - If found:
        * Move to .jules/queue/running/<same-name>
        * Read sidecar meta (if exists) for verify_task
        * Run: ./scripts/run-task.sh <running-file> [--verify <verify_task>]
        * On success (exit 0): move to .jules/queue/completed/
        * On failure: keep in running/ + append error to .jules/queue/runner.log
      - Response: {dispatched: true, filename, task_id, exit_code, duration_ms}
      - Timeout: 1200s (20 min)
      - Auth: operator/admin
      - Audit log (both success and rejection):
          .jules/history/admin_audit.jsonl

   c) GET /api/admin/queue/list
      - Response: {pending: [...], running: [...], completed: [...]}
        Each: {filename, size, created_at}
      - Auth: operator/admin

2. Frontend: view-admin -> New Task section

   Layout:
   ┌─ Queue Status ─────────────────────┐
   │ Pending:   N files                  │
   │ Running:   N files                  │
   │ Completed: N files                  │
   └─────────────────────────────────────┘

   ┌─ New Task ─────────────────────────┐
   │ Prompt:      [textarea]             │
   │ Verify Task: [input, optional]      │
   │                                     │
   │ [📥 Add to Queue]  [▶ Run Next]     │
   └─────────────────────────────────────┘

   Behavior:
   - [📥 Add to Queue]:
       * If textarea empty -> showError("Prompt is empty")
       * Else POST /api/admin/queue/add
       * On success: clear textarea, refresh queue status, toast "Added: admin-abc123.txt"
   - [▶ Run Next]:
       * POST /api/admin/queue/run-next
       * If 400 next_task_not_formed:
           - showError("Наступне завдання не сформовано")
           - Highlight textarea (focus + red border briefly)
       * If success: refresh queue status, show output in admin-output
   - Queue status auto-refresh every 10s (or on action)

   IDs:
   - queue-pending-count, queue-running-count, queue-completed-count
   - btn-admin-add-to-queue, btn-admin-run-next
   - admin-new-task-prompt (textarea)
   - admin-new-task-verify (input)

3. Tests in tests/test_admin_api.py:
   - test_queue_add_writes_file
   - test_queue_add_requires_text
   - test_queue_run_next_empty (400 next_task_not_formed)
   - test_queue_run_next_dispatches (full lifecycle: pending -> running -> completed)
   - test_queue_list_returns_counts
   - test_queue_audit_logged
   - frontend contract: btn-admin-add-to-queue, btn-admin-run-next,
     queue-pending-count, admin-new-task-prompt

REQUIREMENTS:
- Files: smos/api/main.py, frontend/index.html, tests/test_admin_api.py
- No shell=True
- Reuse existing scripts/run-task.sh (do NOT rewrite it)
- Handle missing/empty pending/ gracefully
- Do not modify .jules/queue/pending/.gitkeep

TESTS:
- pytest tests/ + git diff --check

CONSTRAINTS:
- Do not touch .co-smos/, .jules/tasks/, .jules/results/
- Do not modify .jules/queue/pending/*.gitkeep
- No new Python dependencies
- Do not weaken existing tests

REPORT FORMAT: AGENTS.md §14

FINAL REPORT:
1. what already existed and was reused
2. what was added
3. what was deliberately not changed
4. tests/results
5. remaining gaps

LIFECYCLE TEST REQUIREMENT:
The test test_queue_run_next_dispatches must verify the FULL lifecycle:
  pending/ -> running/ -> completed/
not just HTTP 200.

COMPATIBILITY NOTE:
run-task.sh accepts any path (TASK_FILE=$1, cat "$TASK_FILE").
Verified compatible with running/admin-*.txt.
If incompatibility is found during implementation, do NOT modify
run-task.sh — report it in remaining gaps.

Co-SMOS v1.1 — Archive Undo (Selected + Filter by status/date)

CONTEXT:
- Repo: Urania-order/jules
- Backend: smos/api/main.py, smos/core/queue_reset.py
- Frontend: frontend/index.html
- Existing:
    * POST /api/queue/reset-column (Задача 1)
    * GET /api/queue/archive/export?format=csv|md|jsonl (Задача 2)
- Archive format: .jules/queue/reset-YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS.jsonl
  Line format:
    {
      "task_id": "...",
      "status": "...",
      "request": "...",
      "priority": N,
      "created_at": "...",
      "reset_at": "...",
      "scope": "...",
      "restored": false,
      "why": {
        "source_task": null,
        "proposal_origin": null,
        "proposed_by": null,
        "history_transitions": [...]
      }
    }
- Problem: After reset, tasks are archived but cannot be restored.
  No Undo in UI. No filter by status/date.

GOAL:
1. Add POST /api/queue/archive/undo {archive_ids: [...], confirm: "UNDO"}
2. Add POST /api/queue/archive/undo-filter {status, date_from, date_to, scope, search, confirm: "UNDO"}
3. Add GET /api/queue/archive (list archive entries, read-only)
4. Frontend: Reset Center panel with tabs:
    - Columns (existing reset buttons)
    - Archive (list with checkboxes)
    - Undo (filters + Undo Selected / Undo All Matched)
5. Shift+Click range selection for archive checkboxes

REQUIREMENTS:

1. GET /api/queue/archive
- Reads all .jules/queue/reset-*.jsonl
- Response: {entries: [{archive_id, task_id, status, request, priority, created_at, reset_at, scope, restored}, ...]}
- archive_id = "<file>:<line_number>" (unique per entry)
- Auth: operator/admin

2. POST /api/queue/archive/undo
- Request: {archive_ids: [...], confirm: "UNDO"}
- For each archive_id:
    - Find the line in reset-*.jsonl
    - If restored == true → skip (already restored)
    - Create new Task:
        * request = entry.request
        * priority = entry.priority
        * status = "PENDING"
        * why = entry.why (preserve)
        - history_transitions = entry.why.history_transitions +
            [{timestamp: now, status: "PENDING", message: "RESTORED from <archive_id>"}]
    - Add to state.json / tasks
    - Mark archive line restored: true (rewrite .jsonl line)
- Response: {status, restored: [...], failed: [...]}

3. POST /api/queue/archive/undo-filter
- Request: {status?, date_from?, date_to?, scope?, search?, confirm: "UNDO"}
- Find all archive entries matching filter:
    * status: entry.status == status
    * date_from: entry.reset_at >= date_from
    * date_to: entry.reset_at <= date_to
    * scope: entry.scope == scope
    * search: substring in entry.request or entry.task_id
- For each matching entry:
    - If restored == true → skip
    - Create new Task (same as undo)
    - Mark archive line restored: true
- Response: {status, matched: N, restored: [...], failed: [...]}

4. FRONTEND — Reset Center panel
- Section: id="view-reset-center"
- Navigation: <button data-view="reset-center">♻️ Reset Center</button>
- Tabs:
    * id="tab-columns" data-tab="columns"
    * id="tab-archive" data-tab="archive"
    * id="tab-undo"    data-tab="undo"
- Tab "Columns":
    * Keep existing reset buttons (btn-reset-ready..btn-reset-all)
- Tab "Archive":
    * Table id="archive-list"
    * Columns: checkbox, task_id, status, priority, reset_at, scope, restored
    * checkbox class="archive-select" data-archive-id="..."
    * Shift+Click range selection (JS)
- Tab "Undo":
    * Filters: undo-filter-status, undo-filter-from, undo-filter-to, undo-filter-scope, undo-filter-search
    * Shows "Matched: N tasks" (live count via POST /api/queue/archive/undo-filter with dry_run)
    * Buttons:
        - id="btn-undo-selected"      → "↩️ Undo Selected"
        - id="btn-undo-all-matched"   → "↩️ Undo All Matched"
    * Confirm modal: id="undo-confirm-modal", id="undo-confirm-input" (type "UNDO")
- CSS: .reset-center-tabs, .reset-tab, .archive-list, .archive-row, .archive-select,
    .undo-filters, .undo-filter-row, .undo-btn, .undo-matched-count

5. PRESERVE WHY
- When restoring, keep entry.why in the new task
- Add history_transition entry: "RESTORED from <archive_id>"

6. TESTS
- test_archive_list_returns_entries
- test_undo_selected_creates_tasks
- test_undo_marks_restored
- test_undo_preserves_why
- test_undo_skips_already_restored
- test_undo_filter_by_status
- test_undo_filter_by_date
- test_undo_filter_by_search
- test_undo_filter_returns_matched_count
- test_undo_requires_confirm
- test_undo_requires_operator
- frontend contract:
    * view-reset-center, tab-columns, tab-archive, tab-undo
    * archive-list, archive-row, archive-select
    * undo-filter-status, undo-filter-from, undo-filter-to, undo-filter-scope, undo-filter-search
    * btn-undo-selected, btn-undo-all-matched
    * undo-confirm-modal, undo-confirm-input

CONSTRAINTS:
- Do not touch .co-smos/, .jules/tasks/, .jules/results/
- Allowed: read/rewrite .jules/queue/reset-*.jsonl (mark restored: true)
- Allowed: update state.json (add restored tasks)
- Do not weaken existing tests.
- Only operator/admin can undo.
- Preserve WHY from archive.
- Handle empty archive gracefully.

TESTS: pytest tests/ + git diff --check
REPORT FORMAT: AGENTS.md §14

FINAL REPORT:
1. what already existed and was reused
2. what was added (endpoints, filters, frontend)
3. what was deliberately not changed
4. tests/results
5. remaining gaps

  No way to see history of who reset what, when, and why.

GOAL:
1. Append-only audit log: .jules/history/reset_audit.jsonl
2. Entry format:
   {timestamp, action, scope, moved, restored, by, schedule_id, archive_file}
   - action:    "reset-column" | "undo-selected" | "undo-filter" | "scheduled_reset"

   - moved:     number of tasks moved to archive
   - restored:  number of tasks restored from archive
   - by:        username (operator/admin)
   - schedule_id: schedule UUID if action == scheduled_reset, else null
   - archive_file: path to .jules/queue/reset-*.jsonl
3. GET /api/queue/reset/audit?limit=50

   Sorted by timestamp DESC.
4. Hook into existing endpoints:
   - POST /api/queue/reset-column        -> append entry

   - POST /api/queue/archive/undo-filter -> append entry
   - scheduled reset runner              -> append entry

3. Hook points (no behaviour change on happy path):

4. FRONTEND

  But active_task has only {id, request} → all those become null.

    * created_at: null
    * proposed_by: null (author)
    * title: null
    * priority: null
    * started_at: null

  `item[1].get("created_at", "")` — but created_at is always "" → no sort.

    * created_at (auto-gen via datetime.now(timezone.utc))
    * proposed_by (author)
    * title, priority, started_at, finished_at, source_task

   BEFORE:

GOAL:

1. Backend: new endpoints in smos/api/main.py

   a) POST /api/admin/queue/add
      - Body: {text: str, verify_task: Optional[str]}
      - Writes .jules/queue/pending/admin-<uuid8>.txt
        Content: task text (raw prompt)
      - Optional sidecar: .jules/queue/pending/admin-<uuid8>.meta.json
        {"verify_task": "11", "created_at": "...", "by": "operator"}
      - Response: {queued: true, filename: "admin-<uuid8>.txt"}
      - Auth: operator/admin

   b) POST /api/admin/queue/run-next
      - Picks OLDEST .txt from .jules/queue/pending/
      - If none: 400 {error: "next_task_not_formed", message: "No pending task files"}

        * Move to .jules/queue/running/<same-name>

        * On failure: keep in running/ + append error to .jules/queue/runner.log
      - Response: {dispatched: true, filename, task_id, exit_code, duration_ms}
      - Timeout: 1200s (20 min)
      - Auth: operator/admin
      - Audit log (both success and rejection):
